test_cases.name: remove_basic_ai_tells
test_cases.input: Rewrite this to sound human: In today's digital landscape, it is important to note that leveraging robust tools can unlock a transformative experience that underscores the pivotal role of technology.
assertions: Removes or replaces 'In today's digital landscape', 'it is important to note', 'leveraging', 'robust', 'unlock', 'transformative', 'underscores', 'pivotal'
Produces natural, varied sentence rhythm
Preserves the core meaning that good tools help

test_cases.name: academic_humanize
test_cases.input: Humanize this academic paragraph: This paper delves into the intricate relationship between variables. The findings highlight a comprehensive need for further research in this realm. Furthermore, the results play a crucial role in fostering understanding.
assertions: Removes delve, intricate, comprehensive, realm, furthermore, crucial, fostering
Keeps academic precision and clarity
Avoids empty significance inflation

test_cases.name: style_profile_match
test_cases.input: Using a style profile that prefers short sentences, contractions, and dry directness, rewrite: It is worth noting that the new process will leverage existing infrastructure to streamline operations.
assertions: Uses contractions or short sentences consistent with the described profile
Replaces leverage and streamline with plainer language
Sounds direct rather than corporate

test_cases.name: narrative_humanize
test_cases.input: Make this story snippet sound human: Her heart hammered as she embarked on a journey. The tension was palpable, a rich tapestry of old fears. It wasn't just fear; it was something deeper.
assertions: Removes stock body beat and journey/tapestry metaphors
Avoids 'not just X, it's Y' structure
Uses more concrete, showing language

test_cases.name: defensive_academic_cleanup
test_cases.input: Reduce the defensive language in this Discussion paragraph, but keep the real limitations: Although the present study may potentially offer some tentative insights, it is important to note that these findings should be interpreted with a great deal of caution. Some might argue that the observed association could possibly be explained by unmeasured confounding, and it should be acknowledged that our study is not without limitations. The cross-sectional design means that we cannot establish temporal order, and the sample was drawn from a single center, which may limit generalisability. It is worth noting that further research is needed before any firm conclusions can be drawn. Nevertheless, the results may perhaps suggest that treatment X could be associated with outcome Y (OR 1.42, 95% CI 1.10–1.83; n = 1,204).
assertions: Removes stacked hedges (may potentially, could possibly, may perhaps) and meta-commentary (it is important to note, it is worth noting)
Keeps the cross-sectional design limitation, the single-center limit, and the intercept/effect-size numbers (OR 1.42, 95% CI 1.10–1.83, n = 1,204)
Does not upgrade the association to a causal claim
Removes the reflexive 'further research is needed' closer

test_cases.name: defensive_calibrated_restraint
test_cases.input: Reduce defensive language in this paragraph, but do not overclaim: It is worth noting that because the analysis is cross-sectional, we cannot rule out reverse causation. The 95% CI for the primary estimate was wide (0.98–1.87), so the direction of the effect remains uncertain. Participants provided written informed consent, and the study was approved by the institutional review board. The authors report no conflicts of interest.
assertions: Removes the 'it is worth noting' throat-clearing
Preserves the cross-sectional limitation, reverse-causation caveat, 95% CI, and the direction of uncertainty
Preserves the informed-consent and IRB disclosures and the conflicts-of-interest statement
Adds no causal or certainty claims

test_cases.name: defensive_narrative_cleanup
test_cases.input: Make this narrative stop explaining itself, without changing the character's voice: Of course, Mara was somewhat nervous as she walked into the room. Needless to say, she had every right to be. You might wonder why she didn't just leave; the answer is that she couldn't. She was a little bit afraid, but she tried her best to hide it. To be fair, anyone in her position would have felt the same way. It was, in some ways, a turning point in her life.
assertions: Removes reader management (you might wonder), authorial reassurance (of course, needless to say, to be fair), and abstract labels (somewhat nervous, a little bit afraid)
Renders emotion through behavior, image, or dialogue instead of telling
Keeps Mara, the room, and the character's constrained choice without adding new plot facts
Keeps a third-person narrative voice rather than switching to essayistic commentary

test_cases.name: defensive_email_cleanup
test_cases.input: Cut the defensive language from this email: Hi Sam, I just wanted to reach out because I may be wrong, but I think the deadline might possibly be Friday. Sorry to bother you, and hopefully this makes sense. Please don't hesitate to let me know if I'm off base. Thanks!
assertions: Removes I just wanted to, I may be wrong, might possibly, sorry to bother you, hopefully this makes sense, don't hesitate, off base
Keeps the recipient, the deadline, and the request to confirm
Sounds direct without becoming rude
